children: Shares of Tata Consultancy Services surged 5.19 per cent to ₹2,315 on the NSE by mid-morning Tuesday, emerging as the top gainer on the NIFTY TATA 25 CAP index, which itself rose 0.96 per cent to 14,145.15 as of around 11.35 am.

The rally came on the back of TCS announcing a partnership with the Dubai Gold & Commodities Exchange (DGCX) to modernise the exchange’s market infrastructure through a next-generation integrated trading, clearing, and surveillance solution.

Under the agreement, TCS will deploy TCS BaNCS for central counterparty clearing, Quartz for market surveillance, TCS BaNCS Securities Trading, and the Quartz Gateway — which incorporates generative AI-powered reporting and analytics. The platform will support DGCX across energy commodities, currencies, equities, bullion, and precious metals, with room to expand into crypto and tokenised assets.

title: TCS shares jump 5% as DGCX partnership lift stocks
